  • Vivência com geração de leads inbound (redes sociais, site, conteúdo, funil de conversão)
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de marketing digital e analytics (Google Analytics, Meta Ads/Business, ferramentas de automação/CRM)

  • Uso de ferramentas de IA no dia a dia para ganhar eficiência (ex: criação e revisão de conteúdo, briefings, análise de dados, automação de tarefas repetitivas)
  • Vivência em coordenação de eventos (planejamento, execução, fornecedores)

  • Capacidade de pensar estratégia de marca e também executar no detalhe

  • Organização para tocar múltiplas frentes em paralelo


Diferenciais:

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We are hiring for our Paid Media team, looking for an Associate Director, Paid Social — a senior performance leader who combines deep platform expertise with strategic vision, team leadership, and executive-level client management. This is not a tactical execution role; it demands the ability to architect full-funnel paid social strategies, lead a team of practitioners, and drive measurable revenue outcomes across a portfolio of high-growth brands.

The ideal candidate is a recognized expert in Meta direct response advertising with a proven track record of scaling ad accounts well beyond $1M USD per month, building and mentoring high-performing teams, and serving as a trusted strategic advisor to senior client stakeholders. You think in systems, not campaigns — and you hold yourself accountable to the business outcomes that matter.

You'll report to the Managing Director of the department and serve as a senior leader within the Paid Media practice, owning the strategy, performance, and growth of a portfolio of key accounts. You'll collaborate closely with Creative, Analytics, Brand, and Client Strategy teams, and will be responsible for developing the next generation of paid social talent at Darkroom.

This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment designed for marketers who are ambitious, curious, and ready to grow. You’ll gain hands-on experience in a broad range of platforms and verticals, while developing the skills needed to lead performance strategies end-to-end.

Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

What you'll do:

  • Own and drive the overarching paid social strategy across a portfolio of high-growth U.S. brands, ensuring alignment between media investment, creative output, and business objectives.

  • Serve as the executive point of contact for senior client stakeholders — presenting quarterly business reviews, growth roadmaps, and performance forecasts to CMOs and marketing leadership.

  • Partner with the Managing Director to define team OKRs, capacity planning, and service delivery standards across the Paid Social practice.

  • Champion Darkroom's paid social point of view, staying ahead of platform changes, algorithmic shifts, and emerging formats to inform both client strategy and internal best practices.

  • Lead the development of annual and quarterly paid media plans, including budget allocation, channel mix, audience strategy, and creative roadmaps.

  • Oversee campaign architecture, optimization frameworks, and testing methodologies across 8–15 paid media accounts with aggregate monthly spends ranging from $500K–$5M+.

  • Drive best-in-class performance across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Axon, and CTV, with deep mastery of direct response principles and short-form video creative strategy.

  • Establish and enforce rigorous KPI frameworks — CPA, CAC, iROAS, nCAC, MER, aMER, CTR, TSR, and Hold Rate — ensuring data-driven decision-making at every level.

  • Architect and pressure-test attribution models in partnership with Analytics, ensuring clients have a clear and accurate view of cross-channel performance.

  • Proactively identify growth opportunities through competitive intelligence, audience expansion, and creative iteration — translating insights into actionable channel strategies.

  • Serve as the senior creative strategist on accounts, guiding clients and internal creative teams on hook construction, format selection, messaging hierarchy, and creative testing frameworks.

  • Develop scalable creative testing systems that connect production investment directly to performance outcomes.

  • Advise clients on creative budget allocation across UGC, motion, static, and short-form video to maximize return at each funnel stage.

  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of Paid Social Managers and Specialists, setting clear performance expectations and fostering a culture of accountability and craft.

  • Conduct structured performance reviews and build individualized growth plans for direct reports.

  • Establish internal quality standards for campaign builds, reporting, and client deliverables — and ensure consistent adherence across the team.

  • Act as an escalation point for complex performance challenges and client issues, providing senior-level guidance and resolution.

What you'll need to be successful:

  • 10+ years of paid media advertising experience, with at least 7+ years specializing in Paid Social and Meta in particular.

  • 7+ years managing paid social advertising for high-growth consumer brands with aggregate monthly spends of $1M+ across a portfolio.

  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing a team of 3+ paid media practitioners in a fast-paced agency or in-house environment.

  • Proven track record of scaling Meta ad accounts beyond $1M USD/month while maintaining or improving efficiency metrics.

  • Executive-level client management skills — ability to build trust with CMOs and senior marketing leaders, present strategic recommendations with confidence, and navigate complex stakeholder dynamics.

  • Expert-level command of Meta Ads Manager and deep familiarity with TikTok Ads, Pinterest, and emerging social commerce platforms.

  • Mastery of e-commerce performance metrics (CPA, CAC, iROAS, nCAC, MER, aMER, CTR, TSR, Hold Rate) and the ability to translate these into clear client-facing narratives.

  • Expertise in full-funnel creative strategy — from concept briefing to performance analysis — with a sharp eye for what converts.

  • Strong background in data-derived decision-making, budget forecasting, and spend projection modeling.

  • Comfort engaging with e-commerce P&Ls and financial performance metrics at the business level.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to distill complex data into compelling insights for both internal teams and senior client stakeholders.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

About Sybilla Technologies
At Sybilla Technologies, we develop advanced Space Domain Awareness (SDA) and Space Situational Awareness (SSA) solutions that help governments, defense organizations, commercial operators and research institutions better understand, monitor and protect the space environment.
Our technologies support mission-critical operations where reliability, precision, and operational excellence are essential. Joining Sybilla Technologies means becoming part of a growing deep-tech company where engineering excellence, customer partnership and continuous innovation go hand in hand.

You will work with complex observational data from sources such as photometry, spectrophotometry, polarimetry and radio frequency systems. Your work will contribute to anomaly detection, pattern-of-life analysis, attitude and behaviour monitoring, and the development of a comprehensive RSO characterisation data catalogue.
You will combine scientific research with practical operational delivery. This means developing new algorithms and analytical tools, validating data quality, supporting observing campaigns and translating research findings into capabilities that can be used in operational services for civilian and defence customers.

jobs.description:
Department: Technology
Team: North America
Location: Washington, D.C. (home-based)
Position Type: Contractor position until 31 December 2027, with the intention to renew on a rolling contract, subject to business needs. We welcome applications from candidates seeking full-time or part-time working arrangement

What the hiring manager says

"An opportunity to represent Networks and Network manufacturers as a primary technical representative for the GSMA, interfacing within the U.S. and globally with governmental, non-governmental and national/international technical bodies on the technology evolution of mobile networks and their use cases. A particular focus would be Dual-Use scenarios (in 5G, 5G Advanced, 6G and Private Networks, and AI-enabled networking). There will be a further aspect of the role liaising with academic institutions and startups on fostering innovation and service ideas. The role will work closely with the GSMA Chief Engineer to ensure the mobile sector is well represented and also to attract a wider membership base in the GSMA related to Dual-Use opportunities."

GSMA Chief Engineer

About the team

The GSMA Technology Team serves to define industry wide technical strategy, drive global standards alignment, coordinate operator and vendor collaboration, and produce authoritative technical frameworks that shape mobile ecosystem evolution.

  • Technical strategy — Sets long term technology direction for 5G Advanced, 6G, NTN, AI native networks.
    • Standards alignment — Harmonises positions across 3GPP, ITU, ETSI.
    • Ecosystem coordination — Run working groups that unify operators, vendors, and partners.
    • Technical frameworks — Publishes specifications, guidelines, and reference architectures used globally.

About the role

This is a multi-faceted role providing an opportunity for a senior, well rounded engineer to engage with a diverse range of senior stakeholders to shape the evolution of mobile networks in North America and also globally.

Success in the role will be demonstrated in the strength of GSMA’s inclusion in the North American based initiatives around Network Evolution.

The role is part of the North American Team. This team is primarily based in Atlanta and supports GSMA members in North America through regular physical meetings and multiple virtual activities.

The role will provide to the team capability in the following areas:

Technology Communication
• Government Liaison: Represent GSMA within Washington in fora and groups discussing technology evolution of mobile networks to represent GSMA’s technical interest in the enablement of advanced mobile networks globally, including spectrum management and particularly infrastructure deployment in Dual-Use scenarios.
• Technology Input: Provide technical input for submissions regarding global network standards and technology.
• Influence: Promote consensus on technical industry positions, including open RAN, ISAC and AI integration in 6G.

Network Evolution & Member Engagement
• Member Liaison: Serve as a point of contact for US-based operator members on issues related to technology evolution and associated use cases, gathering consensus on network evolution challenges (e.g., 5G standalone rollout, network efficiency, role of ISAC).
• Technical Working Groups: Advise and participate in GSMA North America (and occasionally wider) forums, fostering collaboration between stakeholders to accelerate technical standards.
• Innovation: Foster innovation in all sectors, including academic, on future technology awareness.

Strategic Thought Leadership
• Industry Trends: Analyse and report on the impact of U.S. and NATO policy on global technology trends, particularly regarding 6G and AI-enabled infrastructure.
• Position Papers: Develop white papers and high-level briefs concerning technical aspects of network security, interoperability, and future technology roadmaps.

About you

  • Training: Recognised training in Engineering / Telecommunications.
    • Experience: Significant experience in wireless telecommunications. Ideally with additional experience in Defence Systems development (C3I/Sensors/Data Links) or in a technical policy role.
    • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of 3GPP standards, evolving 5G & 6G architecture, ISAC, spectrum, and network virtualization.
    • Relationships: Established network within NTIA, ATIS and overall U.S. wireless industry.

About your skills

  • Technical Competency: Across the board expertise in communications systems, architectures, security and operation.
    • Strategic Communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts into persuasive arguments and goals.
    • Consensus Builder: Skilled at aligning competing interests of operator members.
    • Communication: Strong drafting skills for documents and public speaking capabilities.

Contract type

Short term Contractor

Worker type

Contingent Worker

What We Offer

Working at the GSMA offers you unparalleled access to the mobile industry. We offer a chance to truly shape the direction of mobile, whatever your role. By joining the GSMA, you will be exposed to a fast-paced rapidly evolving environment, working on global solutions, genuinely fascinating and industry-changing projects and a stimulating and dynamic environment designed to enable you to flourish.

In addition to architect-designed offices and competitive compensation, our benefits include fantastic learning & development opportunities, generous holiday allowances, four additional days off for professional development and many others.

To learn more about the GSMA, visit our career site, our LinkedIn page and our Twitter page.

Being You at the GSMA

We care deeply about diversity, equity and inclusivity and aspire to be the best at it. Your well-being and work/life balance is important, so flexi-time and remote working is available to all staff. We're keen to ensure everyone is equal, represented and connected so we particularly encourage applications from all demographics. The sucess of the GSMA year on year will continue to be contributed by people from all walks of life.

GSMA Values

Our values not only drive our culture – they shape how we work and interact inside and outside our global organisation.

Passionately driven

We approach everything we do with unparalleled capability, tenacity and commitment, knowing that the challenging scale, pace and complexity of our work is what leads to its world-changing impact.

Insightful leaders

We continually develop and engage our expertise, insight and creativity so that we’re always ready to respond to the changing landscape with authority, agility and nuance.

Stronger together

We lean on each other so the industry can lean on us, embracing our diversity by actively seeking out perspectives and skill sets beyond our own, fuelling each other’s successes and constantly asking how we can help.

Underpinning our values is our collective mindset to show up purposefully as good human beings every day, in every situation. When we’re at our best – we are collaborative, considerate and compassionate to others, and we create a safe space for one another to thrive, assuming positive intent in our colleagues. And if we aren’t at our best and the pressure is on – we feel free to be ourselves but still remain curious, lean into the tough stuff and we are always respectful to others and accountable for the part we play.

Remote Work

About Avaaz

Avaaz is an international campaigning and advocacy organisation that provides its global membership of almost 70 million people with opportunities to make our world a better place.

We’re one of the world’s largest online global campaigning movements, with people from every corner in the world taking action to close the gap between the world we have and the world most people everywhere want. This includes protecting human rights worldwide, supporting indigenous struggles, saving our planet from climate change and other threats, and fighting to stop disinformation and other cyber threats from undermining our democracies.

Our model enables people to channel their voices into a powerful collective force at tipping point moments to impact the pressing global challenges of our time, from climate and ecological collapse to human rights abuses and the dismantling of democracy.

Avaaz is funded through small donations from individual Avaaz members, no big money from governments or corporations. This keeps us independent and allows us to keep a laser focus on doing what the world needs.

Language Associate (Dutch) - Part-Time Position (Approx. 20 hours/week)

This is an exciting consultant position that offers a unique opportunity to support large-scale social change efforts. Language Associates bring Avaaz to millions of people each week by translating Avaaz campaigns from English into key languages and rewriting them to be fitting to local contexts. This role requires strong written communication skills and cultural awareness that allow you to capture the heart of Avaaz’ campaigns and powerfully translate them into Dutch language.

The successful candidate for this part-time position (20 hours/week) will work closely with the Dutch language lead and with the Member Engagement and Community Petitions teams, and they will report to an Avaaz staffer. Please note that this position is on a freelance/independent contractor basis.

Responsibilities

  • Translate Avaaz campaigns from English to Dutch to turn them into strong, emotive, and compelling campaigns to send out in The Netherlands and Belgium, and to Dutch-speaking members around the world.
  • Hands-on technical support for campaign development, including setting up email blasts and landing pages in the Avaaz website backend interface, and supporting the drafting and testing of campaigns.
  • Looking for sources for campaigns -- finding relevant, issue-specific, supporting materials from the press, NGOs, etc.
  • Monitor and enhance the Dutch Avaaz website and other tools for functionality and language errors, supporting clear and effective communication with members.
  • Support the Dutch campaign team to write and edit excellent campaign materials such as briefings, advocacy letters, and press releases. Translate and/or edit other materials as necessary: Media material, content for social media etc.
  • Reviewing, managing, and supporting the petitions published by Dutch members on the Avaaz Community Petitions website.

Qualifications

  • Excellent written and oral communication, and translation skills in Dutch, combined with creative thinking to craft engaging texts.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, the Avaaz team’s working language.
  • Professionalism, efficiency, and results-oriented delivery on short timelines.
  • Flexibility and ability to adapt to (somewhat) varying weekly workloads.
  • Passion and commitment to global justice, citizen empowerment, and social change.
  • Strong teamwork skills, comfortable in a highly collaborative culture, and a hierarchical team structure.
  • Proficient in Google Suite and online communication systems (Slack, Zoom, etc).
  • Ideally: cultural and linguistic understanding of regional differences (e.g. the Netherlands and Belgium), to guarantee Avaaz content can be understood across Dutch-speaking regions.

Compensation

This is an independent contractor role, paid at an hourly rate of €25,- depending on experience and location. Contractors are responsible for their own taxes and statutory contributions in their country of residence.

Location

Avaaz is a virtual organization, with most of our work done online. Our staff and contractors are based in locations all over the world. For this position, the candidate would ideally be based in the European/Middle East/African time zones.

Application Timeline

What are we looking for?

The Field BasedSr. Project Engineer is responsible for independently performing testing and evaluation on a variety of products to the provisions of U.S., Canadian and other international product safety standards; writing reports; and communicating with clients.   • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Chaplains are the frontline staff fulfilling the mission and Christian ministry of MCHAP, by using their gifts and talents to serve company employees and their immediate families.

Part-time, Austin, TX

Essential Functions and Responsibilities
• Serves as a messenger and conveyor of faith, mission, and purpose.

Ministry

jobs.excerpt: The Director of Procurement will lead enterprise-wide procurement for a U.
jobs.description:
The Director of Procurement will lead enterprise-wide procurement for a U.S.-based, enterprise software company operating in the healthcare IT market. This role owns end-to-end sourcing strategy, supplier negotiations, contract commercial terms, and supplier performance across key spend categories such as technology (cloud/SaaS/software), professional services, corporate services, and contingent labor. The Director will manage a team of four buyers, partner closely with cross-functional budget owners, and provide executive-level reporting and briefings to ensure spend transparency, risk management, and measurable savings aligned with company priorities.

This leader will also help mature procurement operating processes—category strategies, sourcing governance, supplier relationship management (SRM), purchase-to-pay (P2P) discipline, and compliance requirements typical of healthcare-adjacent environments (e.g., privacy/security expectations, vendor risk management, and data handling requirements).

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Negotiations

  • Lead supplier negotiations across high-impact categories (e.g., cloud providers, SaaS subscriptions, software licensing, systems integrators, consulting, hardware, telecom, facilities, travel).
  • Own negotiation strategy and playbooks: price benchmarking, total cost of ownership (TCO), value-based tradeoffs, escalation paths, and multi-year commercial structures.
  • Drive competitive RFP/RFQ processes, supplier selection, and contracting approaches to optimize cost, quality, delivery, and risk.
  • Establish and enforce negotiation standards (e.g., target discounts, renewal timing, bundling/unbundling strategies, termination/renewal protections, and service credits).

Supplier Relationship Ownership & Performance Management (SRM)

  • Act as the executive owner for key suppliers and strategic partners; build structured governance and QBR routines.
  • Implement supplier performance scorecards (cost, service, quality, responsiveness, security posture, SLA adherence).
  • Manage supplier risk: financial stability, operational risk, concentration risk, and business continuity considerations.
  • Lead issue resolution and escalation management, ensuring fast containment and long-term prevention.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Budget Partnership

  • Partner with cross-functional budget owners (Engineering, Product, IT, Security, Sales, Customer Success, HR, Finance, Legal) to align sourcing to business strategy and annual operating plans.
  • Drive spend planning and demand management: challenge/validate requirements, standardize preferred products/services, and reduce duplicative tools.
  • Support budget owners with renewal calendars, forecast accuracy, and sourcing recommendations ahead of budgeting cycles.

Team Leadership (Management of 4 Buyers)

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of four buyers, ensuring clear role definitions, performance expectations, and career growth.
  • Build scalable procurement workflows (intake, triage, sourcing, contracting, PO management, receiving, and supplier onboarding).
  • Set and monitor KPIs for the team: cycle time, savings, contract coverage, compliance, and stakeholder satisfaction.

Executive-Level Reporting & Briefings

  • Provide executive reporting and briefings on procurement performance, savings pipeline, renewal risk, supplier concentration, and key sourcing decisions.
  • Develop dashboards and regular cadence materials for leadership (monthly/quarterly): realized savings, avoidance, committed spend, and contract compliance.
  • Present sourcing strategy and high-value negotiations to executives with clear options, risk tradeoffs, and recommendations.
  • Track procurement savings, KPIs, and financial performance, reporting to senior management.
  • Ensure alignment with overall financial strategies to improve profit margins.
  • Develop, update, and report on service level agreements, including distribution of metrics to senior leadership; identify root causes of issues and drive efficient resolution.

Contracting Partnership & Commercial Governance

  • Partner with Legal, Security, and Privacy teams to standardize commercial and risk terms, supporting efficient contracting without sacrificing protections.
  • Ensure procurement inputs into contracts include: pricing schedules, SLAs, implementation milestones, data handling/security clauses, audit rights, termination rights, and renewal protections.
  • Maintain contract repository discipline and commercial term visibility (renewal dates, notice periods, auto-renew controls).
  • Ensure all procurement activities comply with company policies, industry standards, and legal requirements.
  • Lead initiatives to mitigate supply chain risks and ensure business continuity.
  • Work closely with Legal and Information Security teams to ensure contract terms comply with company standards.
  • Provide timely support for System and Organization Controls (SOC) audits and manage quarterly vendor reviews.

Process, Policy & Systems Enablement

  • Mature procurement policy and controls: approval thresholds, competitive bidding rules, delegation of authority, and exception management.
  • Improve P2P compliance and reduce “shadow spend” through standardized intake and procurement engagement processes.
  • Optimize procurement systems/tooling (ERP/AP, contract lifecycle management, vendor management tools) in partnership with Finance/IT.

Healthcare IT Vendor Risk Alignment (Commercial Enablement)

  • Coordinate with Security/Compliance to ensure vendors meet required standards for a healthcare IT context (e.g., security questionnaires, data access controls, incident response expectations).
  • Support audits and customer expectations by ensuring third-party relationships have appropriate commercial and operational documentation.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).
  • Minimum 10 years of progressive procurement/sourcing experience, including supplier negotiations and contract commercial management
  • Experience in enterprise software / SaaS / technology environments; healthcare IT experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success leading negotiations with technology vendors (SaaS, cloud, software licensing, professional services).
  • People management experience with direct leadership of a team (or strong evidence of mentorship/leadership readiness); ability to manage and develop a team of 4 buyers.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and partner with budget owners, especially in fast-paced environments.
  • Strong executive communication skills—able to synthesize complex spend, risk, and commercial positions into concise leadership-ready materials.
  • U.S.-based with eligibility to work in the U.S.; comfortable working in a fully remote environment.

Core Competencies / Success Traits

  • Commercial acumen: understands pricing models, renewal dynamics, and total cost levers.
  • Negotiation mastery: balances relationship-building with firm commercial outcomes; knows when/how to escalate.
  • Analytical rigor: strong Excel/modeling skills; can quantify savings and build business cases.
  • Operational discipline: creates repeatable processes, clear accountability, and measurable KPIs.
  • Stakeholder management: trusted advisor to execs and budget owners; able to drive adoption of standards.
  • Leadership: builds a high-performing team culture; coaches buyers to grow capability and autonomy.

Compensation

The salary range provided in this job posting is intended to reflect the general market value for the position. The actual salary offered may vary based on factors such as the candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and the specific requirements of the role. This range may also be subject to change as market conditions evolve. We encourage open communication throughout the interview process to discuss compensation expectations. For base-salary + commission sales roles, the range represents On-Target Earnings.

jobs.excerpt: A FCamara está em busca de uma pessoaEngenheiro(a) de Software AI-Native,para se juntar a nossa equipe dinâmica e atuar em parceria com a maior construtora da América Latina, que ao longo de sua existência, sempre esteve sintonizada com o mercado e as melhores práticas, além de priorizar sempre as necessidades de seus clientes.
jobs.description:
A FCamara está em busca de uma pessoaEngenheiro(a) de Software AI-Native,para se juntar a nossa equipe dinâmica e atuar em parceria com a maior construtora da América Latina, que ao longo de sua existência, sempre esteve sintonizada com o mercado e as melhores práticas, além de priorizar sempre as necessidades de seus clientes.Éuma empresa que está em constante movimento, se reinventando a cada dia para oferecer soluções de moradia para todas as gerações.

Principais atividades

  • Produzir software de forma AI-native: conduzir agentes e LLMs a partir de especificações, mantendo responsabilidade técnica integral pelo resultado. Você especifica, orquestra, revisa e responde pelo código. A IA executa;
  • Conduzir o ciclo de Spec-Driven Development: transformar requisitos em especificações executáveis e artefatos de contexto (ex.: /specify, /plan) que servem de contrato para o trabalho humano e para os agentes.
  • Calibrar a autonomia progressiva da IA conforme risco e maturidade do contexto: saber quando aceitar a geração autônoma e quando intervir manualmente, sem perder o controle do "o quê" e do "porquê".
  • Participar do rito de Pull Request Aumentado, revisando não apenas sintaxe, mas intencionalidade: aderência aos critérios de aceite, decisões técnicas e impacto funcional — inclusive sobre código gerado por agentes, não só por humanos.
  • Contribuir para a camada de conhecimento e os contextos reutilizáveis (skills, padrões, decisões arquiteturais, conectores/MCPs) que tornam os agentes consistentes e confiáveis no domínio da MRV.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de arquitetura e engenharia para entregar código limpo, testável e sustentável, em sistemas de diferentes características (monolitos e/ou distribuídos), com foco em valor de negócio e ritmo sustentável.
  • Contribuir com testes automatizados, observabilidade — inclusive sobre a qualidade e o custo do output de IA — e práticas que reduzam retrabalho e débito técnico.
  • Atuar em times colaborativos guiados por valor, usando metodologias ágeis e práticas como code review, pair e mob programming, compartilhando aprendizados e sendo mentorado(a) por profissionais mais experientes.

Conhecimento técnico (mandatório)

  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência com desenvolvimento de software, com domínio forte em ao menos uma das stacks (.NET e React ) e capacidade comprovada de transitar pelas demais com apoio de IA. Valorizamos experiência Fullstack.
  • Spec-Driven Development como competência central: escrever especificações não ambíguas, decompor em planos verificáveis e definir critérios de aceite que funcionem como contrato para humanos e agentes (ex.: /specify, /plan).
  • Engenharia de Contexto: construção e gestão de contexto para LLMs — instruções, restrições, exemplos, seleção de ferramentas/MCPs e controle da janela de contexto.
  • Uso de IA Generativa e ferramentas agentivas aplicado ao desenvolvimento, com responsabilidade, senso crítico e validação humana sistemática.
  • Leitura crítica de código que você não escreveu: avaliar, validar e corrigir output de IA e de terceiros com a mesma profundidade do próprio código.
  • Habilidade para escrever código de alta qualidade, bem organizado e testável, com domínio de OO e/ou bons princípios de design.
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários e/ou de integração).
  • Uso de Git para versionamento e colaboração via Pull Requests.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e fundamentos de modelagem de dados.
  • Vivência com práticas ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou XP).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prática com orquestração de agentes e MCPs/conectores (composição de ferramentas, automação de fluxos com IA).
  • Familiaridade com avaliação e observabilidade de output de IA (medir qualidade, regressões, custo de tokens) e com arquiteturas model-agnostic.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas, microsserviços ou mensageria.
  • Vivência com CI/CD, automação de build e release.
  • Conhecimento em nuvem e/ou contêineres (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Conhecimento em Python.

Soft skills e comportamentos

  • Clareza de escrita e de especificação como skill de primeira ordem: no modelo AI-native, especificar bem é programar. Quem especifica mal, gera mal.
  • Pensamento crítico e ceticismo técnico: não confiar cegamente em soluções automáticas, especialmente as geradas por IA.
  • Conforto com ambiguidade e com delegar: soltar o controle do "como" mantendo o controle do "o quê" e do "porquê".
  • Autonomia e responsabilidade para buscar soluções sem depender de direcionamento constante.
  • Comunicação clara para discutir requisitos, decisões técnicas e trade-offs.
  • Colaboração e respeito ao time, valorizando o aprendizado coletivo.
  • Adaptabilidade em um ambiente de rápida evolução tecnológica.
  • Importa-se genuinamente com o sucesso do produto e do time.
  • Assume responsabilidades mesmo quando não são formalmente atribuídas.
  • Aprende com erros, celebra conquistas coletivas e se posiciona com coragem diante de decisões difíceis.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise in web scraping, data extraction, and data processing to deliver accurate, reliable, and high-quality results. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Senior Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing tools such as Apify, OpenRouter, and other technologies, alongside your own technical expertise and approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage available tools and custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirement.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern development tools and technologies, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets)

Additional requirements

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and containerization (Docker) as part of real workflows
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, OpenRouter, or similar) applied to automation tasks

  • A link to GitHub is a plus

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $25 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. SUMMARY

An Associate Supply Chain Manager supports and executes supply chain strategies, in alignment with our company's mission and goals, focusing on daily operations like order processing, inventory management, supplier coordination, and logistics to ensure efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and timely product flow from sourcing to delivery, collaborating across departments and managing key metrics. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Inventory Analysis and Management: Monitors, analyzes, controls, manages, and maintains inventory levels. Identify best practice benchmarks and drive improvements in both efficiency and cost savings. Report weekly and monthly with KPIs, inefficiencies, managing risks, and ensuring compliance.
  • Procurement & Supplier Relationship Management: Research and select new suppliers, negotiate contracts, and ensure quality materials are acquired efficiently. Manage current vendor relationships to ensure strong partnerships while managing performance. Discuss product specifications along with vendor requirements with the Print Production Coordinator.
  • Demand Planning and Forecasting: Interpret datasets to uncover trends, forecast demands, and make informed decisions. Analyze historical sales data and provide recommendations to Product Teams on optimal print quantities. Review upcoming campaigns with the Product Teams to predict inventory needs for projected sales, particularly for seasonal products.
  • Communication Management: Identifies high-volume/large-quantity sales orders that impact inventory levels and shares information with the Customer Support team. Shares low/out-of-stock item information back to product teams, business operations, customer support, and other relevant departments with weekly reports.
  • Warehouse and Fulfillment: Works as a liaison between Ascension and our warehouse/fulfillment partners for any inventory-related questions, assessing and monitoring all warehouse transactions, and handling discrepancies; tracks movement of inventory by monitoring purchase order (PO) transactions and ASN receipts from the vendor, both in the ERP system and at our warehouse, matching the invoice to the transactional records.

Inventory Management | Order Inventory | Excel / Google Sheets | ERP | Cycle Counting | Data Analysis | Inventory Control Software | Strategic Planning | Risk Management | Procurement and Negotiation | Problem Solving | Customer Focus | Adaptability and Change Management | Communication | Conflict Management

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Manager of Developer Tooling, you will be tasked with leading the team responsible for designing, building, and operating our CI/CD pipelines. This team sits within the Developer Experience organization and is at the center of how every engineer ships code. You will set the technical direction for our pipeline platform and partner with Infrastructure Services and product engineering teams to deliver a fast, reliable, and self-service path to production.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Lead, grow, and develop a team of engineers building and operating CI/CD pipelines and pipeline tooling.
  • Own the architecture, roadmap, and reliability of our CI/CD pipelines from source to production.
  • Integrate AI capabilities into the developer workflow including AI code review on pull requests, AI generated tests, intelligent test selection and flake detection, AI assisted failure triage, and engineering intelligence dashboards that surface bottlenecks and impact.
  • Partner with the broader DevEx organization to roll out, support, and measure adoption of AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) across product engineering teams.
  • Build paved road templates, reusable libraries, and golden paths that make doing the right thing the easiest thing for product teams.
  • Drive measurable improvements in pipeline reliability, build and test duration, and developer wait times.
  • Partner with security to build supply chain controls, policy enforcement, and AI specific guardrails into the pipeline.
  • Work closely with the Infrastructure Services team that owns CI/CD orchestration, GitOps continuous delivery, artifact management, and related platforms, and with product engineering teams that consume the pipelines.
  • Establish on call practices, incident response, SLOs, and continuous improvement loops for pipeline systems.
  • Recruit, mentor, and grow engineers and create an environment where strong engineers do their best work.
  • CI/CD pipelines are the circulatory system of an engineering organization, and AI is rapidly becoming part of that bloodstream. The Manager of Developer Tooling will lead the team that defines how code reaches production, safely, quickly, confidently, and increasingly with AI as a first class participant in the workflow. This is a critically important role with significant impact on engineering velocity and reliability across the company.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 7 or more years of engineering experience with 2 or more years managing engineers, ideally in DevOps, platform engineering, or developer experience teams.
  • Strong hands-on background with CI/CD systems including Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Tekton, or similar, including pipeline as code patterns.
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI tooling into the development workflow including AI code review, AI test generation, AI coding assistants, or engineering intelligence platforms such as LinearB, DX, Jellyfish, Faros, or similar.
  • Working knowledge of ArgoCD or comparable GitOps tooling and artifact management systems like Artifactory, Nexus, or Harbor.
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes, containers, and cloud native deployment models.
  • Experience designing shared libraries, templates, or platforms used by many internal teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance hands-on technical leadership with people management responsibilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication with the ability to translate technical strategy for both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A service mindset measured by the productivity and happiness of the engineers you serve.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

We're looking for a Product Design Lead to own UX/UI across our Ü Snacks brand portfolio, from launching new products to optimizing site performance and user flows. You'll build scalable design systems, improve conversion across our ecommerce ecosystem, and partner with cross-functional teammates to create best-in-class experiences. This role is perfect for someone who is equal parts strategic and hands-on, deeply curious about customer behavior, and obsessed with great design. If you want to shape how our brands show up online and actually see your work drive conversion, this is that role. You'll report directly to the VP of Ecommerce. This is a hands-on, maker-first role — you'll spend the majority of your time designing and shipping the work yourself, with a smaller people management component.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together twice a year for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead UX/UI across the full funnel (PDP, cart, checkout, account, first-order flow) with an eye on conversion, not just polish
  • Design experiences for new product and brand launches that match packaging quality from day one
  • Own and evolve our cross-brand design system (Figma components, tokens, patterns) so every brand ships fast without quality drift
  • Translate our brand books into a premium digital experience across typography, motion, imagery, and information hierarchy
  • Partner with the CRO team to keep the landing page test pipeline full with high-quality, on-brand variants
  • Manage and mentor a direct report, setting the craft bar and helping them grow into a stronger designer
  • Review and calibrate work across the design team and agency partners, raising the bar on everything that ships

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has 8+ years in product/UX/UI design, including 5+ years designing for premium DTC ecommerce on Shopify or Shopify Plus
  • Has built or rebuilt a design system from the ground up, including tokens, components, documentation, and governance, and can point to real adoption
  • Has a portfolio that shows unmistakably on-brand, premium work, not a templated Shopify build
  • Understands DTC funnel mechanics deeply (PDP, cart, checkout, subscription, upsell) and can explain design decisions in conversion terms
  • Has experience designing across multiple brands or product lines at once
  • Is a power user of Figma and uses AI to speed up their own design process

Approach to the role:

  • Operates as a player-coach: ships work personally and raises the bar for the team around them
  • Thinks in systems and components, not one-off pages
  • Balances craft and conversion on every decision, and can articulate the tradeoff
  • Brings a strong point of view without ego, and collaborates well across growth, brand, lifecycle, and engineering
  • Owns the outcome. Doesn't wait for a perfect brief. Pulls context and moves.

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $140,000-$160,000 plus bonus depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

jobs.title: Director, AI Engagements
jobs.excerpt: Harbor Labs is a new team within Harbor focused on solving hard AI implementation problems in the legal market.
jobs.description:
Harbor Labs is a new team within Harbor focused on solving hard AI implementation problems in the legal market. We have strong hypotheses about what works, but we're building this like a startup: learning as we go, adjusting direction based on what the market tells us, and staying flexible about how we operate.

We're looking for a Director of AI Engagements to lead our most important client relationships and set the strategy for how we deploy AI in production. This is a senior role for someone who can sit across the table from a GC or COO, shape the direction of an engagement, and then roll up their sleeves and build alongside the team to deliver it.

This is a leadership role, but not a hands-off one. You'll own the strategy for your engagements and stay close enough to the work to configure systems, pressure-test outputs, and make the calls that determine whether AI actually sticks in a client's day-to-day.

What Makes This Different:

Our edge is combining deep legal domain experience with product sensibility and strong engineering. We understand how legal teams actually work, what change management looks like in risk-averse environments, and how to build software that people will use. We also know the common pitfalls of enterprise software in traditionally low-innovation areas like law, and we're determined to avoid them.

We focus on hard, novel problems where standard platforms fall short. The work is ambiguous, the solutions aren't obvious, and that's the point. As a senior leader here, you set the bar for how we approach those problems and how we show up with clients.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the strategy for your engagements. Shape what success looks like with the client's leadership, define the roadmap, and make the prioritization calls. You're accountable for the outcome and the relationship, not just the deliverable.
  • Lead at the executive level. Be the trusted partner to GCs, COOs, and heads of legal operations. Translate where AI is heading into a concrete plan they can get behind, and bring skeptics along.
  • Stay hands-on with the work. Configure systems, structure knowledge sources, write and refine prompts, design test cases, and validate outputs against real data. You lead from inside the work, not above it.
  • Set direction for delivery. Define how an engagement is scoped, staffed, and sequenced. Work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and delivery leads to turn an ambiguous business problem into a production system.
  • Design the operating model, not just the workflow. Figure out how AI changes the way a legal team operates: the processes, the roles, the governance. Redesign how the work gets done, then make the change actually happen.
  • Drive architecture and integration decisions. Partner with engineers on how AI fits into client tech stacks: APIs, data flows, security and compliance requirements. Hold the line on what's production-grade.
  • Help build Harbor Labs itself. This is a ground-floor leadership opportunity. You'll shape how we sell, how we deliver, who we hire, and where we go next.

What We're Looking For:

  • You operate like an owner. You've run engagements, programs, or a function end-to-end and been accountable for the result. You set direction when there isn't one and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.
  • You lead from the front, hands on the work. Seniority hasn't pulled you away from the details. You're as comfortable in a configuration screen or a prompt as you are in a boardroom, and you believe the two can't be separated.
  • You've delivered real change in how teams work. You understand legal operations, professional services, or a comparable environment, and you've redesigned how people actually do their jobs, not just shipped a tool.
  • You're deeply fluent in AI, but not captured by hype. You understand how these systems work in production: RAG architectures, agentic workflows, prompt engineering, evaluation methods. You know how to separate signal from noise when every vendor claims to be the next breakthrough.
  • You hold current model-provider credentials. Anthropic Academy certifications (AI Fluency: Framework & Foundations, Claude Code, Building with the Claude API, Model Context Protocol) are a strong plus, and current OpenAI Academy coursework counts too. We treat these as a real signal, not a checkbox: they show you're building with today's tools, not describing yesterday's.
  • You're technical-adjacent and unafraid of it. You don't need to write Python all day, but you can read an API doc, reason about a system architecture, and have a credible conversation with engineers about tradeoffs.
  • You command a room at any level. Executive presentations, working sessions with skeptical users, hard conversations about scope and risk. You build trust fast and hold it under pressure.
  • You're relentlessly practical. You care about what works in production and what changes client behavior, not what sounds impressive in a deck.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. Harbor Labs is new and the market is evolving. You'll set the playbook, not follow one.

Nice to Have:

  • Senior experience in legal operations, legal technology, or a transformation/innovation function
  • Track record leading client engagements in consulting or professional services
  • Experience at a product company (product, solutions, or delivery leadership)
  • Hands-on experience with a broad range of AI development tools and LLM APIs

Why Harbor Labs:

We're a small, senior team working on hard problems with clients who are serious about deploying AI in production. The work is hands-on, the ownership is real, and the leadership you exercise here will directly shape what this team becomes.This is early. You'll have meaningful input into the strategy, the team, and what Harbor Labs grows into.

How to Apply:

Send us a note about why this role interests you and an engagement or initiative you led that you're proud of, ideally one where you set the strategy and stayed close to the work. Examples and references matter more to us than a polished resume.

About Us:

Harbor is the preeminent provider of expert services across strategy, legal technology, operations, and intelligence. Our globally integrated team of 900+ strategists, technologists, and specialists navigate alongside our clients – leading law firms, corporations, and their law departments – to provide essential resources and invaluable insights. Anchored in a rich heritage of deep knowledge, steadfast relationships, and mutual respect, our unwavering dedication lies in shaping the future of the legal industry and fostering enduring partnerships within our community and ecosystem.

Harbor is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, civil union status, national origin, ancestry, age, parental status, disabled status, veteran status, or any other legally protected classification, in accordance with applicable law.

Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.

Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.

We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.

We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.

We are hiring a Support Engineer to join our API Support team. This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role. You'll own customer issues end-to-end: triaging incoming tickets, debugging production behavior across our authorizer and API surface, reasoning through configuration and data flow, and driving problems to resolution, often without needing to hand anything off. You'll work across card lifecycle, authorization decisioning, webhooks, account holder KYC, disputes, and the other configurable layers of our platform, using internal tools, Snowflake, Grafana/Loki, and AI-assisted workflows to move fast.

When issues reveal deeper product gaps, you'll partner with Engineering and Product to surface patterns and get problems resolved upstream. You will also partner with Solutions and Product Delivery to ensure that we deliver clear, timely, and charming customer communications. Your judgment directly shapes customer trust, product reliability, and our ability to scale the Support function without scaling headcount linearly with ticket volume.

Lithic is the card-issuing and payments platform powering some of the most ambitious fintechs and embedded-finance programs in the market. Our customers build on our APIs to issue cards, move money, and run card programs at scale, which means the questions that reach us are rarely "where's the button?" They're "why did this authorization decline at 3:42am ET?", "why is this webhook firing twice?", "is this dispute eligible under Reg E?", "what's the latency on our tokenization endpoint right now?" Customers don't remember when things work. They remember when things break, how fast we fix them, and whether we took the time to set things right. As a Support Engineer at Lithic, you're the person who makes that moment go well.

What You'll Do:

  • Own support tickets from first response through confirmed resolution. No tossing them over the fence.
  • Debug independently by tracing system state, API logs, authorizer decisions, webhook delivery, and data flow across production.
  • Diagnose issues spanning card issuance, authorization decisioning, transactions and settlement, webhooks, account holder KYC, disputes, and other configurable behaviors of the Lithic platform. A typical investigation might involve querying Snowflake to trace a transaction's lifecycle, checking Grafana dashboards for latency anomalies, pulling up the customer's integration in Retool, and documenting the resolution in The Vault
  • Use internal tooling, Snowflake/dbt marts, Grafana/Loki, and AI-assisted workflows (Claude Code, internal agents) to investigate and resolve issues efficiently.
  • Maintain high operational rigor in triage, prioritization, SLA adherence, and customer communication.
  • Surface recurring failure patterns that inform product and engineering improvements. Drive permanent fixes, not just one-off resolutions.
  • Contribute to The Vault (our Notion KCS knowledge base). Write the article you wished existed when you picked up the ticket.
  • Create and update internal tooling using Metabase, Retool, Grafana, and Snowflake.

What You'll Bring:

  • 3+ years in a technical, execution-heavy role: Support Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Implementation Engineer, TAM, or similar. Ideally in fintech, payments, or developer-platform B2B SaaS.
  • Strong debugging instincts and comfort operating in production environments where you won't always have a playbook.
  • Comfortable with using and debugging REST API calls, webhooks, and configuration-driven systems. You are familiar with OpenAPI specs, JSON payloads, and can work through issues with HTTP calls fluently.
  • SQL chops. You can independently write a query against a data warehouse (we use Snowflake + dbt) to answer a customer question without needing to ping a data analyst.
  • Ability to reason through complex system behavior from first principles, not just follow runbooks.
  • Clear, direct written communication internally and customer facing. You explain what happened, why, and what you did about it, without hedging or jargon.
  • A strong bias toward ownership. You'd rather solve the problem than route the ticket.
  • Comfortable using AI tools like (LLMs and coding assistants like Claude Code or Cursor) as a part of your daily workflow.
  • Experience working in ticketing systems (Zendesk, Jira, or equivalent)
  • Strong sense of ownership and ability to work independently in a remote environment

About the Role

You will own the roadmap for improving the compliance experience and effectiveness across our advisor and enterprise customer base — making the product faster, smarter, and more reliable for the people who depend on it every day.

You are equally comfortable prototyping alongside engineering as you are presenting a product strategy to internal and external executives. You do not separate strategy from execution — you own both, and you move fluidly between them.

Domain depth. Platform thinking. You know the difference between building a feature and building a platform. You've made — and defended — the call to expose a capability via API rather than bolt it onto a UI. You think about developers and partner integrations as first-class stakeholders, not an afterthought.

Builder orientation with AI tooling. You are comfortable using AI-assisted development tools — Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent — to build working prototypes and MVPs. You understand what an AI-native SDLC looks like: prompt-driven iteration, rapid prototype validation, and the judgment to know when a vibe-coded MVP is good enough to test versus when it needs to be properly engineered.

You know how to read a funnel, identify where an experience is failing, and fix it with the same craft and precision you'd bring to anything else. jobs.excerpt: There are NO limits to your career: come shape the future and be part of a truly unique global culture at OutSystems!
jobs.description:
There are NO limits to your career: come shape the future and be part of a truly unique global culture at OutSystems!

About This Role

As a Lead Security Analyst, you will lead OutSystems' Security Analyst team in India, driving the day-to-day operations of our Security Operations Center (SOC) and the people who run it. Reporting into the Global SOC Manager, this is a hands-on leadership position: you will manage, mentor, and grow a team of security analysts while remaining close enough to the work to set the technical bar for alert triage, threat monitoring, and incident response. OutSystems runs a cloud-first, multi-cloud estate, and much of what your team defends is cloud infrastructure and cloud-native applications (containers, Kubernetes, serverless, and SaaS), so a strong cloud-security mindset is central to this role. You will be the operational anchor for the India team and partner closely with security engineering, incident response, and global SOC leadership to ensure continuous, high-quality coverage of our cloud environments and global operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the India-based Security Analyst team. Own hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, and career development for the analyst team. Set clear goals and expectations, run regular 1:1s, and build a healthy, resilient team culture across shifts.

  • Own SOC operations and coverage across the cloud estate. Manage day-to-day monitoring, triage, and escalation workflows to ensure timely, consistent coverage of our multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud-native workloads. Define and maintain operational processes, shift schedules, and runbooks, and ensure hand-offs across regions and shifts are seamless.

  • Set and uphold the technical bar for cloud detection and response. Oversee alert triage, investigation quality, and incident handling for cloud infrastructure and cloud-native applications (containers, Kubernetes, serverless, SaaS). Lead the team through incidents, provide guidance on complex cloud investigations, and ensure findings feed back into continuous improvement.

  • Drive quality and measurable outcomes. Define, track, and report on SOC metrics and SLAs (e.g. time-to-triage, time-to-respond, false-positive rates). Use data to identify gaps, reduce noise, and continuously improve analyst effectiveness.

  • Partner across the security organization. Work closely with security engineering and detection engineering to provide analyst feedback on detections, tooling, and automation opportunities. Represent the India team to the Global SOC Manager and wider security leadership, and act as a key point of escalation.

  • Champion continuous improvement. Identify opportunities to improve processes, tooling, automation, and training, helping the team scale with the business and stay ahead of evolving threats.

Qualifications

  • Solid experience (6-8 years) in security operations / SOC analysis, with at least 2-3 years leading or managing a team of analysts.

  • Strong hands-on background in cloud security monitoring, alert triage, and incident response in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), with a clear understanding of cloud-specific attack techniques and telemetry (control-plane/API logs, CloudTrail, identity and network flow logs).

  • Hands-on experience monitoring and responding to threats against cloud-native applications and workloads — containers, Kubernetes, serverless, and SaaS — and familiarity with cloud-native security tooling (CSPM, CWPP, CNAPP, cloud-native SIEM).

  • Proven people-leadership experience: hiring, mentoring, performance management, and running a 24/7 or follow-the-sun operation across shifts.

  • Strong working knowledge of SOC tooling (cloud-native SIEM, EDR, SOAR, logging/monitoring) and of the analyst workflows built on top of them.

  • Solid understanding of the threat landscape, attacker techniques, and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK (including the ATT&CK Cloud matrices), and the ability to translate them into effective triage and response.

  • Practical experience defining and improving SOC processes, playbooks, escalation paths, and operational metrics/SLAs.

  • Working knowledge of Windows and Linux, strong knowledge of cloud platforms and cloud-native architectures, and a good grasp of how detections and telemetry map to real threats.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, able to lead a team, brief leadership, and coordinate across global, distributed teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Computer Engineering, or related field.

  • Hands-on detection engineering experience (writing/tuning detection rules, ideally for cloud and cloud-native telemetry) is a nice to have.

  • Relevant security certifications are a plus, especially cloud-security credentials (e.g. AWS Security Specialty, Azure/GCP security certs, GCP/AWS professional) alongside GCIH, GCIA, CISSP, or CISM.

More about OutSystems

OutSystems is a leading AI Development Platform built for the enterprise. Global organizations trust OutSystems to rapidly build mission-critical apps and agents, modernize legacy processes with agentic systems, and govern their entire AI portfolio across complex regulatory environments, all on one unified platform.

As the future becomes agentic, our customers need us now more than ever. While AI has opened the door to extraordinary possibilities, most large organizations find themselves stuck on one side of the "enterprise gap" because AI by itself doesn't solve their complex use cases and business challenges. OutSystems bridges the "enterprise gap" by combining the speed of generative AI with a deterministic, enterprise-grade framework. We provide the tools for teams of any size to deliver high-quality, reliable AI solutions that drive real business impact.

We are looking for passionate, talented, and motivated people to join us as we empower organizations to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of enterprise software. While we are leading the charge into the agentic era, our mission is broader: we are the platform enterprise leaders trust to evolve their entire business, accelerating innovation through secure, governed human-AI collaboration.

OutSystems is a global company, with more than 900k developer community members, 1,700 employees, more than 600 partners, and thousands of active customers in over 75 countries and across 21 industries. Founded in 2001, OutSystems now has offices in the United States, United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Portugal, Germany, the UAE, Japan, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Australia, India, and Singapore, and includes a thriving, worldwide community of remote employees.

Our customers are some of the world's most recognizable brands across diverse industries— such as Toyota, Heineken, Bosch, KeyBank, and UCLA—who trust OutSystems to deliver ROI and transformational impact.

Consistently recognized as a leader by top analyst firms Gartner, IDC and Forrester, OutSystems continues to shape the future of enterprise software development in the agentic era. We are proud to be named a leader in more than 100 categories on G2, including #1 in Customer Satisfaction in Enterprise Low Code Development, and most recently as a leader in AI Agent Building in the G2 Spring 2026 Reports.

Working at OutSystems

Our culture is built on our core values of Trust, Customer Success, Innovation, and Alignment. We operate as one global OutSystems team, taking ownership to pursue our vision of being the AI platform enterprise leaders trust to build, secure, and evolve their most critical applications and systems.

What do we have to offer you?

  • A company at the vanguard of the agentic revolution, where we don’t just react to AI innovation—we architect it. Joining OutSystems means stepping onto a high-growth rocket ship that combines the fearless agility of a startup with the sophisticated, global foundation of an enterprise powerhouse.

  • Real growth opportunities. We don't just talk about development; we invest in it through structured programs designed to scale your expertise. Whether you are aiming for vertical progression, exploring lateral moves into new domains, or mastering specialized AI skills through our Professional Development Fund and Internal Mobility Program, we provide the resources to get you there.

  • A global collective of world-class talent, where you’ll collaborate with enterprise software legends and sought-after thought leaders. At OutSystems, our industry experts aren't just visionaries—they are accessible, approachable mentors who are deeply invested in your growth as we architect the agentic future together.

OutSystems nurtures an inclusive culture where talented individuals from all backgrounds are empowered to learn, experiment and make an impact. . We believe that driving our next phase of growth requires the radical creativity that only comes from diverse perspectives. We are committed to building a team as global and diverse as the organizations we serve, ensuring every individual can perform to their full potential. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive equal consideration regardless of race, origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.
