Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Ecosystem Services Team, you’ll build and own back-end systems and the integrations that keep our services running, help maintain and evolve the cloud infrastructure the application runs on, and play an active role in keeping the service reliable and healthy in production. You'll do this while collaborating closely with frontend engineers, product managers, CloudEng, and UX and design partners to deliver reliable features.

We are looking for engineers who treat the systems they build as their own: people who are comfortable owning a service end to end, from writing the code to verifying it works as intended in production and monitoring its health.

We are hiring for multiple Ecosystem Services Team back-end teams - each solving their own unique challenges to make the web better for everyone. More details about all hiring teams will be shared in the interviews.

About Ecosystem Services

Ecosystem Services builds and operates the back-end platforms that power Mozilla products and services, with a focus on privacy, security, and delivering critical functionality to Firefox and millions of users worldwide.

Our portfolio spans a diverse set of platforms and services. Representative examples include Privacy Services, which provides the APIs and infrastructure behind Mozilla VPN, Relay (email and phone aliasing), and Monitor (data breach detection and remediation); AutoPush, Mozilla's Web Push platform for securely delivering notifications and real-time updates to Firefox clients; and Remote Settings, Mozilla's platform for delivering configuration updates to Firefox outside the regular release cycle. Together with many other backend platforms across the organization, these services help deliver secure, reliable experiences to Mozilla users every day.

Our teams own services end-to-end from designing and building distributed systems, to operating them in production, improving reliability, and evolving the cloud infrastructure they run on. We work closely with product, frontend engineering, Cloud Engineering, UX, and design partners to build resilient systems that make the web better for everyone.

We're hiring backend engineers across multiple Ecosystem Services teams, each tackling different technical challenges while sharing a culture of ownership, collaboration, and operational excellence. More details about the specific teams and domains will be shared during the interview process.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead backend development, building and maintaining server-side logic
  • Take real ownership of the services you work on: deploy them, operate them, and keep them healthy in production rather than handing them off
  • Work closely with our CloudEng Team to maintain and improve production environments, including monitoring and alerting with tools such as OpenTelemetry, Sentry, Prometheus, and Grafana
  • Participate in an on-call / off-hours support rotation, triaging and resolving production issues, partnering with CloudEng and support teams to investigate incidents, address bug reports, and keep the application running reliably
  • Periodically rotate into a support role, handling releases, dependency updates, and incoming work requests from customer support and other stakeholders
  • Thoughtfully apply AI-assisted development tools to move faster and raise quality, while maintaining good judgment about where they fit and where they don't
  • Partner with and support stakeholders (e.g. front-end, platform), ensuring backend systems, APIs, and data contracts meet their needs
  • Partner with frontend and cross-functional teams to align on project goals, contribute to API design, and ensure backend systems, APIs, and data contracts meet their needs
  • Participate in code reviews to maintain high standards of code quality and system reliability
  • Participate in security and privacy reviews, ensuring all data protection measures meet compliance standards

What you’ll bring:

  • 4+ years of experience in software development with a strong focus on backend technologies
  • Strong professional experience with Python , TypeScript/Node.js, or Rust building back-end services and confidence leading back-end engineering projects.
  • Proficiency with PostgreSQL and SQL query optimization, including relational schema design and migrations with a query builder such as Knex
  • Hands-on DevOps experience on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), with Docker-based build and deploy pipelines. You are comfortable deploying, operating, and troubleshooting services in the cloud rather than handing that responsibility to someone else
  • Hands-on experience with observability and monitoring tooling such as Sentry and Grafana
  • A pragmatic commitment to shipping quality work. You care about the quality and reliability of what you ship, you make sensible trade-offs under real constraints, and you consistently move work to and into production.
  • Strong engineering judgment. You can navigate ambiguity, weigh trade-offs, and make sound decisions with incomplete information, and you know when to ask for input
  • A genuine ownership mindset. You are excited to own a service end to end and have a track record of operating what you build in production, including experience with on-call or off-hours production support
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers and driving technical excellence in code quality, testing, and process improvements

Bonus Points for experience with:

  • Performance / load testing
  • Experience with IaC tools such as Terraform and Kubernetes
  • Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects
  • Djangoexperience

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the UK, Spain and Ireland only.

The Opportunity:

About our Platform:Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves them to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and, of course, do it efficiently and effectively.

The Internal Engineering Platform (IEP) delivered by the Foundations group provides application engineers with the tools, systems and Kubernetes clusters they need to build, deploy and run their workloads.

We are hiring an engineer as part of the creation of a new Foundation’s “Metal” squad. This squad will be responsible for building and provisioning resources including storage, networking and Kubernetes clusters in new environments, starting with our own physical hardware. They will provide a Kubernetes control plane and underlying resources, outside public Cloud, to the rest of Engineering.

What Makes You a Great Fit:You enjoy working with engineers, as well as with the management structures that are there to support you and enable you and your team to do your very best.

You are comfortable working in a remote-first company; communication is key. For us, working together means being collaborative, friendly, kind, and respectful. We operate by consensus, you can contribute to a discussion but then commit to the team decision.

As such, being such a highly distributed company, means we would love someone who is keen on working with distributed systems, too.

You are eager to learn and grow. There is a lot of room for growth and development, and the team has quite a lot of knowledge to share for those who are wanting to learn.

You approach development holistically. The team owns the full life cycle of our code; from writing design docs, to looking at developer feedback, and integration testing. We appreciate engineers who enjoy looking at the big picture, and also notice the details of the brush strokes. The Platform team mainly works with Go, Python, and Shell.

You have experience with operating your code. Since a lot of operators and developers use our software, having some grounding in both of these spaces really helps us with building better platforms for our users.

Datacenter experience.

Participation in an on-call rotation.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Management of our physical “Metal” environment from bare metal to kubernetes.
  • Management of cluster networking components: load balancing, NAT, DNS, CNIs, cross-cluster communication, Routing protocols, Architecture.
  • Management of scheduling and autoscaling.
  • Maintaining Crossplane compositions and Terraform modules for CSP resources common to our users. As well the management of versioning and compatibility for Crossplane and Terraform core as well as providers.
  • Work with our users (Grafana Cloud application teams) to help understand their needs and ensure we’re investing in the right capabilities.

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience with Cluster-API, Tinkerbell, Talos and/or Ceph
  • You’ve worked in or on open source, or other community-based projects previously. At Grafana Labs, “OSS is in our DNA”.
  • Experience with a few CSPs. We run Grafana Cloud on AWS, GCP, and Azure using each’s managed Kubernetes service - EKS, GKE, AKS.
  • Experience operating and managing workloads on Kubernetes. We use Tanka for configuration management with Jsonnet.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes scheduling and projects like Karpenter.
  • Terraform and/or Crossplane experience. We have mixed usage - each has its strengths.
  • Enjoys programming in Go! We love building our own tools, utilities, exporters, etc. that suit our needs and otherwise don’t exist (and open sourcing them).
  • Maybe there’s something missing in this job description that you think you might bring to our table? Feel free to let us know!

In Ireland, the compensation range for this role is €104,000 - €124,800. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

jobs.description:
Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.

Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

Business Consultant, Dedicated Success at ®

Are you an expert relationship builder? Are you experienced at developing deep executive-level relationships with premier strategic accounts?If you want to pursue your professional goals as you help grow an innovative real estate tech company, this work is for you. Join us as our newest Business Consultant, Dedicated Successandhelp change the world of real estate, one home at a time.

The Business Consultant, Dedicated Success is responsible for leading, growing, and retaining’s most strategic and highest-value customer relationships. In this senior role, you’ll manage a portfolio of approximately 25 premier strategic accounts, developing deep executive-level relationships that cement as an indispensable business partner. You will provide a personalized, high-touch luxury experience, overseeing the entire post-sale lifecycle—from strategic implementation and custom training to high-stakes escalations and enterprise-wide renewals. As a strategic leader, you will build sophisticated partnerships based on trust, data-driven insights, and a deep understanding of your customers' long-term business goals.

Top Reasons to Apply:

  • Deliver a High-Touch, Luxury Experience: Manage an elite portfolio of just ~40 premier, highest-value strategic accounts, allowing you the bandwidth to build deep, personalized, executive-level relationships and celebrate key milestones.
  • Provide True Bespoke Consultation: Act as an indispensable business partner by diving deep into your clients' unique operations and utilizing data-driven insights to deliver custom strategies, implementation plans, and best practices.
  • Own the Enterprise Lifecycle: Take full ownership of the post-sale journey - from strategic implementation to high-stakes renewals - while traveling (~10%) to engage clients face-to-face and driving long-term revenue retention for Realtor.com's top footprint.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build strong relationships with a small book of customers (~40 accounts), establishing Rea] as a friendly, trusted business partner.
  • Provide a personalized experience for your customers, learning their business operations and systems in order to provide them with custom consultation, data, and best practices for their [Realtor.com| products and services.
  • Engage with customers on a personal level, celebrating not only their business milestones, but also their personal ones (e.g. birthdays, holidays).
  • Retain and grow revenue with your customers by managing their post-sale experience. This includes product implementation, training, ongoing support, escalations, retention, and renewals.
  • Travel for conferences, events, and customer engagement (~10% of your time).
  • Execute effectively towards company initiatives set by leadership and corporate OKRs.
  • Develop a thorough understanding of all key [Realtor.com| business processes and products, recommending and implementing enhancements that will drive revenue with and improve the experience of high-value customers.
  • Communicate effectively with individuals across all levels of the company, including Sales, Product, Marketing, Technology, Operations, and Finance.
  • Have comprehensive business knowledge and technical skill on Salesforce, Focus Fire, and other enterprise systems.

What You’ll Bring:

To be successful in this role, the Business Consultant, Dedicated Success must be a people person who feels comfortable not only building a relationship with customers, but also building a personal connection. You are a self-starter who excels at managing your own schedules and priorities. You will own the success of your book of business, focusing on revenue retention and growth.

What We Like To See / Measures of Success:

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • 8 years of account management experience –key/major accounts.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work with PCs, Internet and Microsoft applications (Word, Excel, and Outlook).
  • Salesforce experience.
  • Knowledge of the real estate industry.
  • Experience with technical customer support.

How We Work:

We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work three or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. This is a U.S. based, remote role with ~10% required travel.

At Realtor, we recognize that attracting the best talent is key to our strategy and success as a company. As a result, we aim for flexibility in structuring competitive compensation offers to ensure we are able to attract the best candidates.

The quoted salary range represents our good faith estimate as to what our ideal candidates are likely to expect in the listed location. We tailor our offers based on the selected candidate's experience, industry knowledge, technical and communication skills, location and other factors that may prove relevant during the interview process. All ranges are location based, ranges for positions in other locations may vary based on the local market.

The annual OTE for this position is $112,000 - $135,000 USD.

How We Reward You:

Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to:

  • Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage
  • Family forming benefits
  • 13 Paid Holidays
  • Flexible Time Off
  • 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off
  • Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3.5% company match
  • Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non-degreed programs
  • 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions
  • Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program
  • Free snacks and refreshments in each office location

Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com®

Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow.

Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. The Cloud Security Engineer will be responsible for protecting Microsoft 365 and Azure environments through secure architecture, identity controls, information protection, governance, automation, and operational excellence. While approximately two-thirds of the role focuses on Microsoft Purview and enterprise data protection, the engineer will also play an active role in Azure security, identity management, cloud workload protection, and security automation.

Primary Responsibilities Data Security & Information Protection (60–65%)

  • Design and maintain the organization's enterprise data classification strategy.
  • Administer and optimize Microsoft Purview.

• Implement and maintain:

◦ Sensitivity Labels ◦ Auto-labeling Policies ◦ Data Loss Prevention (DLP) ◦ Retention Policies ◦ Records Management ◦ Insider Risk Management ◦ Communication Compliance ◦ Intune Policy Protection measures

  • Develop Sensitive Information Types (SITs), Exact Data Match (EDM), and Trainable Classifiers.
  • Identify sensitive information across Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, and supported cloud repositories.
  • Continuously improve data governance through policy tuning, reporting, and operational reviews.
  • Prepare the organization for AI technologies such as Microsoft 365 Copilot through effective classification and information protection.

Cloud Security Engineering (20–25%)

  • Secure Microsoft Azure workloads and cloud-native services.
  • Implement security best practices across networking, storage, compute, and platform services.
  • Configure and maintain Microsoft Defender for Cloud recommendations.
  • Develop and maintain Azure Policy initiatives.
  • Review cloud configurations against CIS Benchmarks and Microsoft Security Baselines.
  • Participate in cloud architecture reviews and security design discussions.
  • Support vulnerability management and remediation efforts across cloud environments.

Identity & Access Security (10–15%)

  • Administer Microsoft Entra ID security controls.
  • Develop and maintain Conditional Access policies.
  • Support Privileged Identity Management (PIM).
  • Secure enterprise application registrations and service principals.
  • Review permissions, delegated access, and application consent.
  • Assist with identity governance initiatives and Zero Trust adoption.

Security Engineering & Automation (5–10%)

  • Develop PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation.
  • Build KQL queries for operational reporting and investigations.
  • Integrate Purview and Azure telemetry into SIEM platforms.
  • Improve security operations through automation and orchestration.
  • Document repeatable operational procedures and engineering standards.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience securing Microsoft cloud environments.
  • Hands-on administration of Microsoft Purview.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Experience securing Azure resources and cloud-native services.

• Strong understanding of:

◦ Microsoft 365 Security ◦ Information Protection ◦ Identity & Access Management ◦ Zero Trust Architecture ◦ Data Governance

  • Experience with Microsoft Defender technologies.
  • Familiarity with scripting using PowerShell.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with:

  • Microsoft Defender for Cloud
  • Azure Policy
  • Azure App Registrations
  • Microsoft Graph API

• KQL

  • Wazuh or OpenSearch
  • Logic Apps and Power Automate

Professional certifications such as:

  • Microsoft Certified: Information Protection Administrator Associate
  • Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate

What we offer our employees:

A positive impact on Your Future:

  • 401(k)/Roth plan with immediate eligibility and employer match up to 6%
  • Employee stock ownership plan
  • Discounted rate on primary home mortgage
  • Credit and housing counseling as well as free financial education tools available to customers and employees

Benefits to improve your health:

  • Two medical plans available – low-deductible PPO plan or HDHP with Health Savings Account
  • Dental and vision insurance
  • Employer paid life insurance, and short- and long-term disability coverage
  • Retirement plan with generous company match and employee stock purchase option
  • Voluntary life insurance options for employee, spouse, and children

The opportunity to nurture your well-being:

  • Paid holidays and paid time off
  • Bonus plan
  • Opportunity for merit raises
  • Employee reward and recognition programs
  • Community service opportunities

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Job Title: Director, Marketing AI Transformation

Department: Marketing
Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer (CMO)
Location: Remote

Role Summary:

The Director, Marketing AI Transformation will serve as the driving force behind the adoption and scaling of AI technologies across the marketing organization. This individual will serve as a bridge between senior leadership, marketing teams, and cross-functional stakeholders, ensuring AI tools and strategies align with the company's broader business objectives. By identifying high-impact use cases, fostering a culture of AI literacy, and championing responsible AI practices, this leader will position the company to achieve operational excellence and innovation in marketing.

In addition to leading adoption efforts, this role will establish and chair a cross-functional Marketing AI Council. The Council will act as a guiding coalition, bringing together key stakeholders from all functions of marketing, as well as representatives from IT and legal to ensure the responsible, strategic, and cohesive implementation of AI within marketing.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Strategic Use Case Development:
    • Collaborate with CMOs, VPs, and team leads to identify and prioritize AI-driven marketing use cases that deliver measurable business value.
    • Pilot initiatives that demonstrate the potential of generative AI in improving efficiency, personalization, and ROI across marketing campaigns.
  2. AI Council Leadership:
    • Establish and lead a Marketing AI Council composed of cross-functional leaders and contributors to guide the marketing team’s AI strategy.
    • Ensure the Council operates as a hub for ideation, oversight, and alignment on AI adoption efforts, shared learning, facilitating discussions, and documenting outcomes.
    • Develop AI governance frameworks and usage guidelines in collaboration with the Council to address ethical, operational, and security considerations as it relates to marketing usage.
    • Represent marketing’s best interest on the corporate IT-led AI Council and share best practices and learnings across the organization
  3. AI Literacy and Enablement:
    • Lead the development of AI literacy programs, including training for marketers at all levels on tools, ethical considerations, and best practices.
    • Work with the Council to establish and communicate AI usage guidelines across the organization.
  4. Change Management:
    • Drive cultural and behavioral change by inspiring teams to embrace AI as a tool for creativity and efficiency.
    • Create a robust communication plan to share wins, lessons learned, and insights from pilot projects.
  5. Leadership and Influence:
    • Act as an influencer and thought leader, working with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to build buy-in for AI adoption.
    • Foster relationships with key executives and managers to overcome resistance and address concerns.
  6. Performance Measurement and Reporting:
    • Develop and track KPIs to measure the impact of AI tools on marketing performance, such as cost savings, time-to-market, and content quality.
    • Regularly present updates and insights to the CMO and other senior leaders.

Qualifications:

  • Experience:
    • 10+ years in marketing, with experience across multiple functions such as content creation, demand generation, analytics, and brand strategy.
    • At least 5 years in a management or leadership role with a focus on change management and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Familiarity with AI tools like generative AI platforms, marketing automation systems, and data analytics tools.
    • Understanding of the AI adoption curve and best practices for scaling AI in large organizations
  • Leadership Skills:
    • Proven ability to lead initiatives without direct authority by influencing across organizational levels and functions.
    • Experience in founding or leading councils, task forces, or similar collaborative bodies to drive strategic initiatives.
  • Educational Background:
    • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business administration, or a related field (MBA or advanced degree preferred).

Alternate Titles:

  • Marketing AI & Innovation Leader
  • Marketing Operations & AI Strategy Director
  • Director, Marketing AI Transformation
  • Head of Marketing AI Integration
  • AI-Driven Marketing Strategy Lead

Ideal Candidate Attributes:

  • Deep Curiosity and Enthusiasm for AI:
    The ideal candidate has a forward-thinking mindset and passion for exploring how AI can transform marketing’s impact on the business. They stay ahead of industry trends, proactively seek opportunities to apply AI in impactful ways, and inspire their teams to embrace innovation with confidence.
  • Exceptional Communication Skills:
    With the ability to articulate complex AI concepts in simple, compelling terms, this leader can effectively engage diverse audiences, from technical teams to senior executives. They excel in presenting ideas, facilitating discussions, and securing alignment across stakeholders to ensure a shared vision for AI adoption.
  • Strong Organizational Skills:
    Managing multiple pilot programs, strategic initiatives, and cross-functional collaborations requires exceptional organizational capabilities. This individual is adept at prioritizing tasks, allocating resources, and ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope, even in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
  • Proven Leadership and Influence:
    The candidate leads by example, fostering trust and collaboration across teams and levels of the organization. They thrive in environments where they must influence without direct authority, rallying support for AI initiatives through persuasive storytelling, data-backed insights, and consistent engagement.
  • Strategic and Results-Oriented:
    Balancing a strategic mindset with a focus on execution, this leader excels at identifying high-impact use cases that align with business objectives. They are committed to delivering measurable outcomes, whether through cost savings, time efficiencies, or improved campaign performance.
  • High Adaptability and Resilience:
    This individual demonstrates flexibility and resilience. They can navigate ambiguity, pivot when necessary, and stay motivated in the face of challenges, continuously driving the organization toward its transformation goals.
  • Commitment to Ethical AI Practices:
    A champion of responsible AI, the candidate ensures that AI adoption aligns with ethical guidelines, safeguarding brand reputation and promoting trust. They actively address concerns related to privacy, security, and fairness, fostering an environment of accountability and transparency.
  • Collaborative Team Builder:
    The ideal leader is skilled at assembling and nurturing cross-functional teams, such as a Marketing AI Council. They recognize and amplify diverse perspectives, creating a culture where experimentation, innovation, and knowledge-sharing thrive.

About Rimini Street, Inc.

Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end-to-end, mission-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software.

Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects.

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.

We are actively seeking an experienced Sr. Director, AI Powered Service Delivery & Automation to join our team. This remote U.S.–based role reports to the GVP of Global Service Delivery Operations.

Position Summary

The Sr. Director, AI-Powered Service Delivery & Automation is responsible for defining and executing Rimini Street's AI-powered managed services strategy and leading the transformation of AMS from a labor-based support model to an intelligence-driven, automation-enabled service delivery organization. Leveraging AI, agentic workflows, AIOps, observability, and autonomous operations, this leader will design and scale capabilities that improve engineer productivity, automate service delivery activities, accelerate issue resolution, reduce cost-to-serve, and enhance client outcomes across ERP and cloud platforms.

This role is accountable for establishing and achieving measurable automation, AI adoption, productivity, service quality, and service economics targets across the AMS portfolio while driving the adoption of next-generation delivery capabilities globally.

The successful candidate will bring a proven track record of deploying AI and automation at scale within managed services environments and delivering measurable business outcomes through operational innovation. Success will be measured by increases in automated and AI-assisted resolution rates, reductions in manual engineering effort and cost-to-serve, improvements in service margins, and the establishment of scalable autonomous support capabilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Lead AI-Powered Service Delivery Transformation

  • Define and execute the roadmap for AI-driven managed services across ERP and cloud platforms.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities to automate diagnosis, triage, resolution, knowledge creation, documentation, and client communications.
  • Establish business cases, governance, and measurable objectives for automated resolution, ticket deflection, engineer productivity, service quality, and margin improvement.
  • Partner across Delivery, Engineering, AI, Product, and Operations teams to drive innovation and adoption.

Build AI-Enabled and Autonomous Service Operations

  • Design and deploy AI-powered assistants, copilots, agentic workflows, and enterprise knowledge capabilities that improve support effectiveness and consistency.
  • Leverage AI, large language models, automation platforms, and knowledge assets to automate support activities and enable autonomous service operations.
  • Establish standards for AI governance, operational controls, performance measurement, and responsible AI adoption.
  • Drive the transition from reactive support to predictive, proactive, and autonomous service delivery.
  • Design and deploy capabilities that increase automated and autonomous case resolution while reducing manual engineering effort.

Drive AIOps and Intelligent Operations

  • Implement AIOps, observability, monitoring, and analytics capabilities to predict, prevent, and remediate service disruptions.
  • Advance self-healing operations through automated remediation, anomaly detection, event correlation, and predictive service management.
  • Partner with ServiceNow and infrastructure teams to mature ITOM, CMDB, service mapping, discovery, and operational intelligence capabilities.

Lead AMS Delivery Transformation

  • Build and lead a global AMS Automation & AI Center of Excellence responsible for AI engineering, intelligent automation, service innovation, and next-generation delivery capabilities.
  • Transform AMS delivery from manual, case-driven execution to AI-assisted and automation-enabled workflows.
  • Standardize scalable delivery patterns, automation frameworks, and operational practices across ERP and cloud service offerings.
  • Drive adoption across global delivery teams and leadership to ensure solutions are embedded into day-to-day operations.
  • Partner with Product, Sales, and Delivery leadership to develop AI-enabled service offerings that enhance client value and differentiate Rimini Street in the marketplace.

Improve Productivity and Service Efficiency

  • Deliver capabilities that reduce administrative overhead and improve resolution speed, throughput, first-contact resolution, and engineer productivity.
  • Implement AI-assisted troubleshooting, intelligent routing, knowledge recommendations, automated documentation, and reusable resolution patterns.
  • Establish measurable improvements in cost-to-serve, service quality, and operational performance.

Deliver Scalable Platform Automation

  • Design and implement reusable automation solutions across ERP and cloud platforms, including diagnostics, monitoring, integration management, configuration validation, and release impact assessment.
  • Modernize service management processes by embedding automation, improving workflow efficiency, and enhancing operational visibility and reporting.
  • Ensure solutions are scalable, practical, and aligned to client, delivery, and business outcomes.

Desired Experience

  • 12+ years leading enterprise managed services, service operations, or technology transformation organizations.
  • Proven track record implementing AI-driven automation, autonomous operations, or digital labor solutions that materially improve service delivery performance and economics.
  • Experience deploying AI platforms, agentic workflows, enterprise knowledge systems, copilots, and intelligent automation capabilities at scale.
  • Strong technical leadership with credibility across architecture, engineering, AI, operations, and executive stakeholder communities.
  • Experience with AIOps, observability, ITOM, predictive operations, automation frameworks, and enterprise service management platforms.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise application support models across ERP and cloud platforms, including SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft technologies.
  • Demonstrated success building new capabilities and leading global transformation programs that improve automation rates, productivity, service quality, customer outcomes, and margin performance.
  • Experience delivering measurable reductions in support effort, ticket volume, or cost-to-serve through AI, automation, or autonomous operations.
  • Experience leading geographically distributed engineering, platform, or automation teams within a global managed services organization.

Desired Skills

  • Deep expertise in AI-driven service delivery, agentic automation, autonomous operations, AIOps, observability, and intelligent automation platforms.
  • Strong technical foundation in APIs, integrations, orchestration, automation frameworks, and enterprise service management technologies.
  • Ability to translate technology innovation into measurable business outcomes, including productivity gains, cost reduction, service quality improvements, and margin expansion.
  • Technology-first leadership style with the ability to lead at strategic, architectural, and operational levels.
  • Proven success driving organizational transformation, stakeholder alignment, and adoption across global teams.
  • Exceptional analytical, communication, and influencing skills with experience building and scaling high-performing teams and Centers of Excellence.

Education

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) required; advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred.

Location

Remote – U.S.

Why Rimini Street?

jobs.description:
Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Senior E-commerce UX/UI Designer

Compensation range: $2,000 AUD - $3,000 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: A specialist agency focused on improving website performance for e-commerce brands by enhancing user experience and increasing conversion rates. They partner with teams to deliver site audits, data-driven redesigns, and strategic growth support aimed at turning existing traffic into revenue.

Role Overview: We are looking for a highly experienced Senior E-commerce UX/UI Designer to help create and optimise high-performing digital experiences for direct-to-consumer brands.

This role is suited to someone who has worked with established global agencies or leading e-commerce brands and can confidently take a project from early strategy through to a complete, development-ready design.

You will work across full website redesigns, new site builds, landing pages, conversion optimisation projects and ongoing website improvements. Some projects will begin with an established brand and clear guidelines, while others may involve taking limited brand information and turning it into a practical digital design system that can scale across an entire website.

The ideal candidate combines strong visual design skills with commercial thinking, UX strategy and a deep understanding of how customers shop online.

Key Responsibilities:

Full Website Design

  • Design complete e-commerce experiences from the ground up, including homepages, collection pages, product pages, cart experiences, navigation, search and supporting content pages.
  • Translate brand positioning, customer insights and business goals into clear, engaging digital experiences.
  • Create scalable design systems that can be used consistently across templates, sections and future pages.
  • Design with development feasibility, responsiveness and Shopify implementation in mind.
  • Produce detailed, development-ready designs that minimise ambiguity during the build process.

UX and Conversion Strategy

  • Understand the full customer journey, from discovery and consideration through to purchase and retention.
  • Identify the questions, concerns and barriers customers may experience throughout the buying journey.
  • Structure pages and content to improve clarity, trust, product understanding and conversion.
  • Balance brand storytelling with usability and commercial performance.
  • Design for a wide variety of products, customer types and purchase journeys.
  • Contribute to CRO strategy and help prioritise improvements based on expected customer and business impact.

Landing Pages and Campaign Design

  • Design high-converting landing pages for campaigns, product launches, paid traffic and specific customer segments.
  • Adapt page structure and messaging based on traffic source, customer awareness and campaign goals.
  • Work across different landing page formats, including long-form sales pages, advertorials, listicles and product-focused pages.
  • Develop page concepts quickly when timelines require it, without compromising attention to detail.

Website Optimisation and Audits

  • Review existing websites and identify opportunities to improve usability, clarity, merchandising and conversion.
  • Conduct structured UX and CRO audits across desktop and mobile experiences.
  • Turn findings into clear, practical design improvements.
  • Work on both new website projects and ongoing optimisation programs.

Figma and Collaboration

  • Work confidently and efficiently in Figma.
  • Build organised files, components, libraries, variables and reusable design patterns.
  • Clearly document interactions, responsive behaviour and implementation requirements.
  • Lead designs through internal and client feedback rounds.
  • Iterate quickly while maintaining consistency across the broader experience.
  • Collaborate closely with strategists, project leads, developers and clients.
  • Communicate the reasoning behind design decisions clearly and constructively.
  • Review implemented work and support design QA before launch.

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of significant professional experience designing e-commerce websites and digital shopping experiences.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating full website designs, not only individual screens or isolated concepts.
  • Proven experience designing a website from initial concept through to a complete, development-ready system.
  • Experience working with direct-to-consumer brands across a range of product categories.
  • Experience working within a respected agency, global agency or similarly high-standard design environment.
  • Advanced Figma skills and strong experience creating scalable design systems.
  • A strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first customer behaviour.
  • Experience designing landing pages across different products, audiences and campaign objectives.
  • Awareness and an understanding of how design influences conversion, average order value and customer confidence.
  • Excellent attention to detail across typography, spacing, hierarchy, consistency and interaction design.
  • The ability to move quickly when needed while knowing when a project requires deeper research and consideration.
  • Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
  • The ability to work independently, manage priorities and take ownership of design outcomes.

Highly Regarded

  • Experience with Shopify and an understanding of Shopify themes, templates, sections and platform constraints.
  • Experience working with CRO programs or experimentation teams.
  • Experience using heatmaps and session recording tools such as Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar or Mouseflow.
  • Experience conducting UX, CRO or heuristic website audits.
  • Experience supporting developers through implementation and completing detailed design QA.

AI-Assisted Design and Creative Workflows

  • Use AI to accelerate the early stages of a project without allowing it to replace strategic thinking, design judgement or attention to detail.
  • Bring all concepts back into a structured, professional Figma workflow using established design principles, reusable components and clear design systems.
  • Understand when AI can improve speed or expand creative possibilities, and when traditional research, design craft and human judgement are required.
  • Use AI tools responsibly, with appropriate consideration for brand consistency, accuracy, copyright and the quality of the final customer experience.

How You Work

  • You are equally comfortable creating a new experience from a blank canvas and improving an established website using customer and performance data.
  • You can work at pace when a project requires momentum, but you do not rush important strategic decisions. You know when to explore, when to simplify and when to move into execution.
  • You are highly attentive to detail and take pride in producing complete, considered work. You think beyond how an individual page looks and consider how the entire system functions across different devices, templates and customer journeys.
  • You are collaborative, commercially minded and confident explaining your design decisions. You are open to feedback, comfortable iterating and focused on achieving the strongest outcome for the brand and its customers.

What Success Looks Like

  • Complete, cohesive e-commerce experiences that reflect the brand and support its commercial goals.
  • Design systems that developers can implement efficiently and brands can continue to use as they grow.
  • Clear improvements to usability, customer confidence and conversion opportunities.
  • Design files that are organised, detailed and ready for development.
  • Strong collaboration across strategy, design, development and client teams.
  • Consistently high-quality work delivered with care, ownership and attention to detail.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

Job Description:

Providing for loved ones, planning rewarding retirements, saving enough for whatever lies ahead – our policyholders count on us to be there when it matters most. It’s a big ask, but it’s one that we have the power to deliver when we work together. We collaborate and innovate – pushing one another to transform not just Pacific Life, but the entire industry for the better. Why? Because it’s the right thing to do. Pacific Life is more than a job, it’s a career with purpose. It’s a career where you have the support, balance, and resources to make a positive impact on the future – including your own.

We're actively seeking a talented PFML-Absence Management Claims Consultant to join our Workforce Benefits Division. As a PFML Absence Management Claims Consultant, you'll play a key role in building and delivering a best-in-class Paid Family and Medical Leave claims experience. This role will serve as a PFML subject matter expert and will be responsible for helping design and build the future-state PFML claims operation. The PFML Claims Consultant will partner closely with Product, Technology, Legal, Compliance, and Operations teams to define business requirements, support system configuration and testing, develop workflows, create claims procedures and training materials, drive process improvements, and ensure regulatory requirements are effectively translated into scalable operational solutions. This individual will help build the foundation for PFML claims administration while delivering an empathetic, compliant, and customer-centered experience for employees and employers.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise, regulatory knowledge, critical thinking, and compassion while helping customers navigate important life events.

How you'll help move us forward:

  • Serve as a key business partner in the design, implementation, and ongoing enhancement of Pacific Life's Paid Family and Medical Leave (PFML) capabilities.

  • Partner closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Technology teams, and external vendors to define business requirements, user stories, workflows, business rules, and system functionality needed to support PFML administration.

  • Act as the PFML claims subject matter expert (SME) throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, testing, implementation, and production support.

  • Help design and build the end-to-end PFML claims experience, ensuring processes are scalable, compliant, efficient, and customer focused.

  • Develop and maintain claims procedures, workflows, job aids, training materials, and operational documentation aligned with state regulations, product design, and system capabilities.

  • Participate in system configuration reviews, user acceptance testing (UAT), workflow validation, defect identification, and implementation of new PFML products and enhancements.

  • Serve as a SME and monitor evolving state PFML legislation and regulatory requirements and translate business and compliance requirements into operational processes and system functionality.

  • Consult on industry best practices and recommend innovative solutions to improve the customer experience, claims outcomes, operational efficiency, and automation opportunities.

  • Partner closely with Legal, Compliance, Employer Services, Customer Service, Operations, Product, and Technology teams to ensure compliant and effective administration of PFML programs.

  • Administer and adjudicate Paid Family and Medical Leave (PFML) claims from intake through resolution, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant claim decisions.

  • Interpret state-specific eligibility requirements, benefit calculations, waiting periods, leave durations, and documentation requirements.

  • Effectively communicate claim decisions, requirements, next steps, and benefit information to claimants, employers, brokers, and internal partners.

  • Demonstrate an empathetic and customer-centric mindset while assisting employees during significant family, medical, and caregiving events.

  • Identify opportunities to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, quality, and compliance within the claims organization.

  • Assist with onboarding, training, mentoring, and development of team members.

  • Participate in audits, quality reviews, special projects, process reviews, and departmental initiatives.

  • Support and promote change management, innovation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Demonstrate sound judgment and discretion regarding confidential and sensitive information.

The experience you bring:

  • College degree or equivalent work experience preferred.

  • 5+ years of experience in Paid Family and Medical Leave (PFML), disability claims, leave management, absence management, insurance claims, or a related field.

  • Strong knowledge of state PFML programs, leave laws, regulatory requirements, and employer-sponsored leave and disability products.

  • Experience interpreting statutes, regulations, policy provisions, administrative guidelines, and complex business requirements.

  • Demonstrated ability to make fair, balanced, and objective decisions with a high degree of integrity and professionalism.

  • Strong analytical, investigative, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with customers, employers, brokers, and internal partners.

  • Customer-focused with a compassionate and empathetic approach to helping employees navigate significant life events.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, including Product, Technology, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Customer Service.

  • Experience supporting process improvement initiatives, workflow design, procedure development, training, quality assurance, testing, or system implementation activities.

  • Detail-oriented with the ability to learn and become proficient in claims administration systems, workflow tools, reporting platforms, and related technologies.

What makes you stand out:

  • Insurance designations, industry certifications, and experience with FMLA, ADA, Disability, or integrated absence management programs are preferred.

Base Pay Range:

The base pay range noted represents the company’s good faith minimum and maximum range for this role at the time of posting. The actual compensation offered to a candidate will be dependent upon several factors, including but not limited to experience, qualifications and geographic location. Also, most employees are eligible for additional incentive pay.

Your wellbeing is important to Pacific Life, and we’re committed to providing you with flexible benefits that you can tailor to meet your needs. Whether you are focusing on your physical, financial, emotional, or social wellbeing, we’ve got you covered.

jobs.description:
About EarnIn

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.

We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

POSITION SUMMARY

We are the Platform-as-a-Service Engineering team at EarnIn. We don’t just manage infrastructure; we build the foundational "Paved Road" that enables our product teams to ship with velocity and safety. Our stack is built on AWS, EKS, and Argo CD, but our future is Agentic. We are shifting from manual configuration to AI-augmented orchestration, in which the platform anticipates developers' needs and self-heals through intelligent automation. We're seeking a Platform Engineer (I3) who is an AI-native builder, someone who doesn't just use AI tools but designs and deploys AI agents to eliminate toil, accelerate developer workflows, and multiply what a lean team can deliver. You will own solutions across Kubernetes (AWS EKS), GitOps (Argo CD), CI/CD (GitHub Actions), and our developer portal (Cortex), while relentlessly automating repetitive operational work through agentic AI.

As an I3 engineer, you are a professional contributor who effectively represents the team's perspective and communicates across functions. You will collaborate with DevX, SRE, and Product Engineering peers to turn fragmented workflows into AI-powered golden paths, building agents that handle incident triage, environment provisioning, config generation, and developer self-service, so engineers can focus on high-value work rather than tickets, aligned with our Platform Engineer growth matrix.

This is a remote position, though it could also be a hybrid role from our Mexico City office as part of our expanding site. EarnIn offers excellent benefits for our employees, including healthcare, internet and cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Mountain View headquarters. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • AI-Agent Development: Design, build, and iterate on AI agents that automate platform operations, from service and infra bootstrap, intelligent incident diagnosis, automated runbook execution, to self-healing infrastructure and PR-review bots. Own the agent lifecycle: prompt engineering, tool/function-call orchestration, evaluation, and production monitoring.
  • Workflow Automation with AI: Identify and eliminate repetitive human-in-the-loop workflows across CI/CD, environment management, access provisioning, and change management.
  • Kubernetes Infrastructure: Support our Kubernetes platform on AWS EKS, with a focus on environment hygiene and security; execute cluster-level tasks and updates with minimal support, and leverage AI for anomaly detection, capacity recommendations, and automated remediation.
  • Developer Experience: Utilize our developer control plane (Cortex) to maintain paved paths and self-service actions, helping teams move from idea to production with minimal friction.
  • Observability & Excellence: Strengthen operational excellence by monitoring SLOs/error budgets and utilizing Datadog for metrics, traces, and logs to improve system reliability.
  • Platform Development: Develop platform services using industry best practices that enable operational excellence for Data, CI/CD, and Security.
  • Service Standardization: Maintain service scaffolds and templates that encode testing and telemetry standards, ensure alignment with platform baselines, and use AI to auto-generate and validate configurations against them.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years in platform, infrastructure, or backend engineering with deep knowledge of Kubernetes (EKS) and cloud-native architectures on AWS.
  • Demonstrated experience building AI agents or agentic workflows, not just using Copilot or ChatGPT, but designing multi-step AI systems that autonomously perform operational tasks (e.g., LLM-powered runbook agents, intelligent CI/CD bots, self-service assistants with tool-use/function-calling).
  • Track record of automating away repetitive workflows with AI. You should be able to point to specific examples in which you replaced manual processes with AI-driven automation, enabling a team to do more with fewer resources.
  • Experience in GitOps (Argo CD) and CI (GitHub Actions) for multi-service systems.
  • Strong coding skills in Go and/or Python, treating infrastructure as software.
  • Excellent communication skills; able to clearly convey technical issues and advocate for both the team's and the customer's needs.
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or custom agent architectures) and prompt engineering for production systems.
  • Mission-Driven: A strong advocate for the customer who takes initiative to fix issues and constantly asks, "Can an AI agent do this instead of a human?"
  • Experience with service mesh (e.g., Linkerd) and traffic management patterns is a plus.
  • Hands-on contributions to developer productivity insights and observability for cost-aware engineering decisions are a plus.
A Note on AI in the Hiring Process: EarnIn may use Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered tools during the hiring process, including tools that generate summaries or notes for interviewers, review resumes, assist with scheduling, or help identify themes across candidate responses and profiles for a given role. Final hiring decisions are made by human interviewers and hiring managers. If you have any concerns about the use of AI in our hiring process, please connect with your recruiter. With your consent, EarnIn may use AI tools to help transcribe or summarize interviews. Recordings are treated as confidential candidate data and are accessible only to authorized hiring personnel. Declining to be recorded will not negatively affect your candidacy or evaluation.

At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. EarnIn does not unlawfully discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. EarnIn is an E-Verify participant.

EarnIn does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or HR team.

We harness cutting-edge AI to optimise energy assets, from commercial and industrial demand response through to utility-scale battery storage, renewable generation, and distributed energy resources.

This role will focus on identifying commercial market opportunities, supporting regulatory compliance, enabling market access, and driving revenue growth for GridBeyond’s energy products and services.

You will work closely with sales, operations, product, trading, and leadership teams to ensure GridBeyond is well positioned to participate successfully across US energy markets, including wholesale power markets, ancillary services, demand response, capacity markets, and flexibility services.

This is a key role for someone with strong knowledge of the US energy market landscape, regulatory frameworks, MISO ISO/RTO market structures, and the commercial drivers behind battery storage, renewables, demand response and distributed energy resources.

What will I be doing?

Market Strategy Development

  • Conduct comprehensive market analysis to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and threats across US power markets, including wholesale markets, ancillary services, capacity markets, demand response and other flexibility service

About Vantage Data Centers

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Global Procurement & Supply Chain Governance Department
The Global Procurement & Supply Chain Governance team supports procurement, source-to-pay processes, supply chain performance, supplier management, working capital visibility, and enterprise decision-making. The team partners closely with Finance, Operations, IT/Data, and procurement stakeholders to improve data quality, build trusted analytics, and translate business needs into measurable operational improvements.

Position Overview

This role is based remotely in the United States.

Vantage is seeking a Director, Procurement Intelligence & Predictive Analytics, Global to lead the strategy, development, and adoption of advanced analytics capabilities across Procurement, Supply Chain, and Finance. This role will drive enterprise-wide data-driven decision making by transforming complex global data into actionable insights that improve operational performance, optimize working capital, mitigate risk, enhance supplier outcomes, and support executive and strategic business decisions.

The Director will define and execute the global roadmap for procurement analytics, predictive and prescriptive modeling, machine learning, and decision intelligence solutions across Demand-to-Delivery, Source-to-Pay, supplier performance, spend analytics, inventory and asset management, and cash flow forecasting. Working closely with senior leaders across Procurement, Finance and Technology and Business Functions, this role establishes scalable analytics capabilities, data governance standards, and reporting frameworks that enable informed decision-making and deliver measurable business value worldwide.

Essential Job Functions

  • Own and lead the global strategy, roadmap, and governance for procurement analytics, data science, and decision intelligence capabilities that enhance procurement performance, supplier management, sourcing effectiveness, contract compliance, and spend optimization.

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to Procurement, Finance, Technology and executive leadership by translating complex procurement, supplier, inventory, and supply chain data into actionable insights, business strategies, and measurable outcomes.

  • Lead the design and deployment of predictive and prescriptive analytics capabilities, leveraging machine learning, statistical modeling, optimization, forecasting, and decision intelligence to drive enterprise value using both internal and external data sources.

  • Oversee the development and implementation of analytical models supporting demand forecasting, supplier risk management, capacity planning, inventory optimization, lead-time prediction, anomaly detection, and cash flow forecasting.

  • Establish and champion executive dashboards, supplier scorecards, KPI frameworks, and reporting standards that provide visibility into procurement, supply chain, fulfillment, and project performance across the organization.

  • Drive enterprise-wide working capital and cash flow optimization initiatives through advanced analytics of purchasing activity, payment timing, inventory investments, accruals, supplier terms, and capital project spending.

  • Partner with senior leaders across Finance, Procurement, Operations, Technology, and business functions to improve forecasting accuracy, scenario planning, capital allocation, operational efficiency, and supplier performance.

  • Lead transformation initiatives across Source-to-Pay processes by identifying strategic opportunities for automation, compliance improvement, process optimization, and operational excellence.

  • Advance procurement analytics capabilities that increase guided buying adoption, spend visibility, purchase order compliance, invoice matching accuracy, goods receipt management, and overall procurement effectiveness.

  • Establish and maintain global procurement data governance standards, including data quality frameworks, master data management, metadata, lineage, controls, and stewardship practices.

  • Drive a culture of data-driven decision making by promoting analytics adoption, enhancing self-service capabilities, and ensuring analytical insights are embedded into business operations and strategic planning.

  • Influence enterprise data and analytics strategy through collaboration with technology and data teams, ensuring scalable solutions, strong governance, and sustainable business impact.

  • Mentor and develop analytics talent while fostering best practices, innovation, and continuous improvement across the analytics organization.

  • Additional duties as assigned by Management.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Supply Chain, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree (MS, MBA, or equivalent) preferred.

  • 10+ years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, quantitative strategy, or a related discipline, including experience leading enterprise-scale analytics initiatives.

  • 5+ years of experience supporting or partnering with Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Operations, or other enterprise business functions, with demonstrated influence at the leadership level.

  • Proven experience developing and executing analytics strategies, roadmaps, and operating models that drive measurable business outcomes and organizational transformation.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders and translate complex analytical insights into strategic recommendations, business decisions, and investment priorities.

  • Deep expertise in advanced analytics, machine learning, statistical modeling, forecasting, optimization, and modern cloud data platforms such as Azure Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or similar technologies.

  • Experience leading the development of enterprise reporting, KPI frameworks, executive dashboards, and self-service analytics capabilities using Power BI, Tableau, or similar technologies.

  • Strong understanding of procurement operations, strategic sourcing, supplier management, spend analytics, working capital optimization, Demand to Delivery, Source-to-Pay, Asset & Inventory, and supply chain performance management.

  • Familiarity with procurement and ERP platforms such as Coupa, SAP Ariba, Oracle, Workday, Yardi, SAP ERP, or similar enterprise systems.

  • Expertise in data governance, master data management, data quality, metadata management, lineage, stewardship, and enterprise data management best practices.

  • Experience integrating and leveraging procurement, finance, supplier, inventory, contract, project, ERP, and payment data to drive strategic insights and operational improvements.

  • Preferred experience in data center infrastructure, construction, capital projects, procurement analytics, finance analytics, supply chain analytics, or other CAPEX-intensive environments.

  • Experience building, mentoring, and developing analytics, business intelligence, or data science talent preferred.

  • Professional certifications such as CDMP, CPSM, CIPS, PMP, or related credentials are preferred.

  • Travel up to 20%, with flexibility to increase as business needs evolve.

Physical Demands and Special Requirements
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

Additional Details

  • Salary Range: $180,000-200,000 Base + Bonus (this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations)

  • This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Operate as the program-management engine of Marketing's planning system and turn organizational problems into solutions. When a cross-functional gap surfaces (for example, "we can't measure ROI because spend data is unreliable"), you'll run intake, drive root-cause analysis, draft the problem statement, and build a first-cut solution and proposal for leadership review.
  • Run the mechanics of the planning operating rhythm (MOR, QBR, Monthly Forecast, OKR updates). Agendas land ahead of time, pre-reads are tight, decisions get logged, and follow-ups don't drop.
  • Implement scalable processes that help us plan and manage work spanning Strategy, Resources, and Governance. You'll be the forcing function that gets cross-team process work done on schedule, working alongside the functional owners who execute it.
  • Identify connections and reconcile possible collisions across planning inputs, cycles, and cross-functional dependencies with BizOps, GTM Ops, Analytics, and FP&A.
  • Ensure transparency, alignment, and clear communication of planning status, decisions, and cycle milestones across Marketing leadership and cross-functional partners.
  • You'll gather the business requirements for our planning data layer (spend data, aggregated investment views, program-to-headcount views), define the end-to-end build plan, and drive it to completion across the owning teams. You own the requirements and the timeline. you are not the builder.
  • Contribute to the development of the strategic planning operations function. Share back the practices, frameworks, and tools that work so the function scales beyond any single cycle.
